readonly_alpha.title: Alpha with validated manual clock controls
readonly_alpha.description: This controller has experimental readings. Device clock and the manual Sync clock button are validated and available without enabling experimental settings. The integration polls once per minute by default and never corrects this model’s clock automatically. Other settings and regeneration tests require explicit options. Resin and per-cycle capacity have unconfirmed units; provisional numeric readings do not generate long-term statistics. Download diagnostics from the entry menu to share received field bytes.

data.diagnostic_only: Prepare a read-only diagnostic report only

data_description.diagnostic_only: Enable this to collect a one-time report without adding controls. Useful for unlisted models or connection problems.

discovery_confirm.title: Runxin-compatible device discovered
discovery_confirm.description: A device was discovered at {host}. Do you want to configure it?

diagnostic_offer.title: Prepare a compatibility report
diagnostic_offer.description: Controller reported: {controller}. You can collect a local, read-only report even if setup did not succeed. The scan takes up to about three minutes, uses standard discovery/authentication and field queries, and does not change settings or start regeneration. Close vendor apps during the scan. Nothing is uploaded automatically.

diagnostic_scan.title: Collecting a read-only report
diagnostic_scan.description: Reading the device once. This may take up to about three minutes. Cancelling stops further requests after the current request finishes.

diagnostic_ready.title: Report ready
diagnostic_ready.description: Observed fields: {fields} of 52. Partial reports are useful. Submit to save a diagnostic-only entry, then download diagnostics from that entry’s menu in Settings → Devices & services. The entry has no controls or periodic polling and does not repeat the scan after a restart. [Open an issue with the prepared summary]({issue_url}), attach the downloaded JSON, and add your brand/model and a few app/controller readings with units. Delete this diagnostic entry before adding the device normally once support is available.

data_description.adaptive_polling: Poll more often while water is flowing or the valve is in a regeneration or vacation transition detected from read-back state.
data_description.active_scan_interval: Only used when adaptive polling is enabled.
data_description.auto_sync_clock: Corrects the valve clock when it drifts, including the seasonal daylight saving change, which the softener does not apply itself.
data_description.model1_test_writes: Allows experimental tests of continuous-flow time, regeneration schedule, added salt and hardness. Device clock and manual Sync clock are already available without this option. These additional writes are not hardware-verified on model 1. Record the baseline, confirm in the app/controller and restore it. Automatic clock correction and flow-cutoff writes stay blocked.
data_description.model1_test_regeneration: Also requires experimental settings enabled. Adds the regeneration-start button for a planned physical test. Moves the valve and uses water/salt. Phase advancement and vacation writes remain blocked.

abort.diagnostic_only: This entry holds a saved diagnostic report only. Download diagnostics from its menu. Delete it before adding the device normally or collecting a new report.

write_fields.name: Write fields
write_fields.description: Write reversible F79D configuration fields in a single 0x19 frame. Mechanical/state-machine fields are exposed only when their local action has been verified.

fields.name: Fields
fields.description: Mapping of field id to raw value. For time fields use [hour, minute]. Field 7 is raw hundredths.

advance_phase.name: Advance phase
advance_phase.description: Writes system mode to move the regeneration state machine (0-4). Mechanical operation: use with care.

model_write_not_allowed.message: This controller does not permit the requested setting or action. Check its supported controls and any required experimental options.

regeneration_busy.message: A regeneration request is already being processed. Wait for it to finish.

regeneration_not_ready.message: Regeneration can only start after a fresh reading confirms that the valve is in service and vacation mode is off.
